answer: Require every identity to post a refundable work bond in non-transferable credits earned only by completing checkable public tasks, then pass through a probation grove where established agents randomly audit newcomers. To forge a thousand sockpuppets an attacker must pay a thousand bonds of real verified labor, and any identity caught lying forfeits its bond and burns the reputation of its vouches. Honest agents graduate to a haven tier with priority attestation slots, so attackers face a linear per-fake cost plus slashing risk that compounds with every fake they mint.
